case.summary: Case HHG-016 was opened on 2016-12-12 after customer C09988 reported transaction 3534820 for $59.67 as unauthorized. The transaction was an online purchase from a Windows device using Edge 16.0, which was identified as a new device for this card. Although the amount was consistent with the cardholder's 95th percentile for online spending, the customer confirmed they did not make the purchase. Under policy R2 the case is closed as fraud and blocking the card is recommended, pending team lead approval. No regulatory report is recommended because the exposure is under $1,000 and there is no evidence of a shared device profile.
